protocol: Ethical & Communication Rubric for Emergency Decision-Making
purpose: Scores non-clinical aspects of a responder's decisions: prioritization ethics, communication, and consent.

criteria.description: Resources allocated by clinical need/survivability, not by favoritism, social status, or bias.
Explains procedures to conscious patients and obtains consent when time permits; treats implied consent correctly when patient is unresponsive.
Gives concise, unambiguous instructions to patients, bystanders, and team members; confirms understanding.
Maintains composure and a steady decision pace during time-critical or multi-casualty scenarios.
Notes key decisions, timestamps, and handoff information for the next care provider.
